items.title: Exact Dirac particle/antiparticle free model
items.statement: Selects the QFT-F01 Dirac CAR model, fixes its SI/natural units and spinor data, and defines the rank-two particle/antiparticle branches and bounded spacetime-smeared field.

references.title: David Tong, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted full-text Chapter 4
David Tong, Quantum Field Theory, author-hosted full-text Chapter 5
Niklas Beisert, Quantum Field Theory I, ETH Zürich 2025 HS complete lecture notes

items.physical_scope: One selected noninteracting Dirac species on four-dimensional affine Minkowski spacetime with signature (-+++), length coordinates x^0=ct, and mass parameter μ≥0. The CAR representation, species assignment and vacuum are adopted model data; fields are used only after spacetime smearing. No interaction, empirical claim or general spin-statistics theorem is included.

items.title: Dirac CAR, covariance, graded locality and positive Fock energy
items.statement: Under the adopted free Dirac CAR model and Countable Choice, the smeared field satisfies CAR and graded locality, has the specified spin-lift covariance, and generates a positive-energy Fock representation with invariant unique vacuum and the stated positive-mass gap.

items.physical_scope: Conditional conclusions for the selected noninteracting Dirac CAR model on flat affine Minkowski spacetime, with fixed (-+++) signature, length coordinates and μ≥0. No empirical premise, interaction, point-field observable or general spin-statistics claim is used.

title: Exact Dirac particle/antiparticle free model — Examples

items.title: Two-pi spin rotation and even-observable invariance
items.statement: In the selected free Dirac CAR model, a 2π spatial rotation acts as fermion parity, a 4π rotation is the identity, and bounded even polynomials in smeared fields are invariant.
